verdicts.reason: A keeps more of the city imagery, but the diamond collage has broken down into a hard-edged rectangular photo block with stray white diamond fragments. The 'Fenix Ave' diamond sits on top of this mess, and the date diamond floats alone at the far right. There is dead white space above the headline, and the divider line has dropped to the bottom-right corner, cut off from the headline. B is worse: the collage is gone, leaving a small stamp-sized photo and an empty white lattice of diamond outlines on the right, an obvious leftover. The body copy is tiny and set apart from the headline, the three diamond/photo blocks are spread evenly across the top with no hierarchy, and the divider line floats with no purpose. B's two-line headline is stronger, but the brand imagery is mostly lost.
